rows.summary: 12 atomic changes. Introduces transfer conditions for the Area Development Agreement, including a $10,000 transfer fee and requirement to sign then-current agreement for term ending at expiration. Introduces curable default and cross-default provisions for the Area Development Agreement, including a 30-day cure period and franchisor discretion to treat franchise defaults as area development defaults.

oldEvidence.quote: We can sell, assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of the Franchise Agreement, or any or all of our rights and obligations under the Franchise Agreement, to any one in our sole discretion.

the proposed transferee signs our then current form of Franchise Agreement (and signs and completes all other agreements, instruments, and documents then used by us in granting and transferring franchises including, if transferee is a business entity, guaranties signed by all direct and indirect owners of transferee, including business entities and individuals); ; and the Transfer is completed

newEvidence.quote: We can sell, assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of the Franchise Agreement, or any or all of our rights and obligations under the Franchise Agreement, to any one in our sole and absolute discretion.

the proposed transferee signs our then current form of Franchise Agreement for a term ending on the expiration date of your Franchise Agreement (and signs and completes all other agreements, instruments, and documents then used by us in granting and transferring franchises including, if transferee is a business entity, guaranties signed by all direct and indirect owners of transferee, including business entities and individuals); and the Transfer is completed
Until the date the last Franchise Agreement identified on the Development Schedule is signed.

No renewal or extension is contemplated under the Area Development Agreement, but we may extend the Development Schedule in our sole and absolute discretion, which may be conditioned on a reduction in the size of the Development Area, modification of the Development Schedule, your execution of a general release, or your execution of a current Area Development Agreement.
We can terminate if you are in default or breach of the Area Development Agreement (including the Development Schedule) and/or other agreement or instrument with us or our affiliates.

We can terminate if you are in default or breach of the Area Development Agreement, for reasons other than failing to comply with the Development Schedule, after a 30-day cure period. We may also, in our sole and absolute discretion, deem you in default under the Area Development Agreement if you are in default under a Franchise Agreement or other agreement with us and have not cured that default within any available cure period.
Pay any balance of the Area Development Fee owed, including the balance of principal and earned interest of any promissory note executed to finance the Development Fee.

We can sell, assign, transfer, or otherwise dispose of the Area Development Agreement, or any or all of our rights and obligations under the Area Development Agreement, to anyone in our sole and absolute discretion.

you pay our then current transfer fee (presently set at $10,000); the proposed transferee signs our then current form of Area Development Agreement for a term ending on the expiration date of your Area Development Agreement

If you die or become incapacitated, the Area Development Agreement must be transferred to a third party acceptable to us within 12 months after the date of death or incapacity, subject to earlier expiration or termination due to your default under the Area Development Agreement.

You and your Owners (if you are a business entity) may not own or be involved with a Competitive Business. A “Competitive Business” means any business which offers residential plumbing products and services competitive with or similar to those offered by us, our affiliates, our franchisees, licensees or affiliates’ franchisees, licensees, and members, without regard to geographic location, other than as authorized by the Area Development Agreement or any other agreement between us.

For 24-months after transfer, termination, or expiration under the Area Development Agreement, you (and your Owners if you are a business entity) may not directly or indirectly (including on behalf of a spouse, sibling, or child, or on behalf of or through any other person or entity) own or be involved with a Competitive Business in the Development Area or any zip code where any of your Franchised Businesses served customers during the Development Term.

rows.summary: 3 atomic changes. The disclosed franchise term duration increased from a fixed 10 years to an option of 10 or 20 years, materially altering the contract term.
